text_block_list.text:
Having thoroughly electrified the crowd, 
Air Groove emerged victorious in the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn).

She and Silence Suzuka etched this match 
deep into their hearts, making a promise 
to have an even greater race together 
someday.

After the race, Air Groove expresses her 
heartfelt gratitude to her Trainer for 
believing in her and sticking by her side 
all the way here.
